data.name: base
data.variable: The functional map of the artifact: its elements, and each receiver's purpose served by a provider's encounter function.

data.ef: records functional types and receiver-owned purpose joins, serves their selected knowledge and memory to agents, and carries findings and work against stable functional addresses
data.purpose: Prepare and maintain project-specific functional understanding so agents improve an artifact from its purposes, dependencies, and retained knowledge across sessions.

data.ef: loads independently declared modules and supplies one common base through which their capabilities reach the command line, MCP, and project records
data.purpose: Extend Metaform with reusable capabilities that share project storage, settings, lifecycle, events, commands, and agent-facing guidance.

data.ef: stores named workflow logic at functional addresses, binds calls to visible element values, and transports calls and results through persistent nonces
data.purpose: Author and evolve reusable agent workflows whose calls use the workpiece's functional records while preserving authored logic and resumable handoffs.

data.ef: discovers bundled, home, installed-entry-point, and project modules, checks their declarations and dependencies, and runs their verbs and lifecycle through a per-call Context and shared public base
data.purpose: Add and remove capabilities through declared modules while keeping their commands, settings, tasks, events, and data owned consistently.

data.ef: serves one tool per enabled module plus chassis commands, command help, resources, and slash prompts over stdio, creates a Context for each call, and refreshes declarations and instructions
data.purpose: Make project context and module operations available to connected agents with live guidance and the same command semantics.

data.ef: stores named Axiom subroutines in knowledge layers, reads visible element values, binds arguments and returns, serves workflow skills and lexicalization instructions, and transports sequential or parallel nonce handoffs for agents to interpret
data.purpose: Reuse authored functional logic while preserving bound project values and continuation state between agent calls.

data.ef: reads authored prompt resources, composes current module guidance and skills, versions stored prompts and their uses, and stages terminal edits as retained prompt revisions and source-change packets
data.purpose: Supply agents with authored instructions whose source and revisions remain inspectable.

data.ef: delivers published topics to enabled subscribers with their own Context and individual outcomes, relays map changes between processes, and closes module-owned listeners and asynchronous tasks with lifecycle
data.purpose: Let modules coordinate changes and notify long-running processes without owning duplicate communication machinery.

data.ef: issues unique seven-digit nonces tied to module verbs, persists and atomically updates continuation values, exposes only current call frames, and retains closed identifiers so completed assignments are never reused
data.purpose: Resume a particular call or agent handoff with its bound state and return to its caller.

data.ef: builds a wheel from the installed chassis and enabled module declarations, carries pure-Python dependencies and resource files, lists compiled dependency requirements, and includes a direct-execution launcher
data.purpose: Distribute a selected set of modules with the same common base and required resources.

data.ef: creates a local module repository from the template, binds six platform and Python check reports to reviewed sources, dispatches quality review before wheel creation, and dispatches template-upkeep pull requests
data.purpose: Help module authors maintain their extension repository against released chassis and template versions.

data.ef: writes work as a plain archive with sealed data and provenance, verifies manifests and lineage before opening it, and reconstructs textual and binary variations using bundled expansion scripts
data.purpose: Carry a workpiece and its retained Metaform data across homes with inspectable lineage and detectable changes.

data.ef: demonstrates shared storage, settings, events, tasks, reports, lifecycle and nonce use in hello, and supplies an empty MODULE declaration and documented public imports in template
data.purpose: Give module authors a working reference and a minimal starting declaration for every supported extension surface.

data.ef: would hand incoming work and its project context to the workflow_builder skill through a routing mechanism that has not yet been implemented
data.purpose: Route incoming work to the workflow builder before it proceeds so the affected functions receive the workflow's rules.

data.ef: states requirements, reasons, observable behavior, build detail, acceptance conditions, relationships, and decision status for the map, layers, storage, chassis, interfaces, projects, and viewer
data.purpose: Maintain an implementable account of Metaform's intended semantics and behavior, including the reasons and unresolved decisions that govern changes.

data.ef: provides the governing requirement records, rationale, trace, and open decisions against which runtime behavior and its verification are assessed
data.purpose: Preserve the intended functional semantics while the implementation evolves.

data.ef: explains installation, intake, map reading, knowledge layers, addressed memory, refinement, and project exchange with concrete commands and worked examples
data.purpose: Make the functional-map method and its supported operations understandable enough to use and maintain project context.

data.ef: documents declarations, lifecycle, shared public services, example usage, packaging, and per-module responsibilities through the extension guide and module READMEs
data.purpose: Document the extension contract clearly enough that a module author can build against the shared chassis and maintain compatible modules.

data.ef: directs code and artifact survey, role and namespace inference, receiver-owned purpose and encounter traces, observed findings, annealing, and a final connected-map proof
data.purpose: Improve functional intake so it captures this artifact's notable types and receiving purposes rather than implementation layout or nonfunctional variants.

data.ef: supplies the procedure served by intake prompt with its project target and explicit ignored paths
data.purpose: Give the intake agent the operative method for examining the current project and recording its functional shape.

data.ef: defines namespace_address, canonical name, name_length, role, purpose, encounter function, flow direction, recursive element encounters, and project-boundary links for intake records
data.purpose: Express the resulting map with stable element identities and receiver-owned purpose joins in a consistent recursive form.

data.ef: provides authored module guidance, workflow libraries and skills, dispatch instructions, and standalone task prompts, with source placeholders and semantic rules retained in their declared resources
data.purpose: Maintain operative agent instructions and reusable task logic whose semantics survive serving, editing, and workflow preparation.

data.ef: supplies the source texts read from package prompt resources and registered prompt sources, including libraries, skills, field help, state instructions, and operation-specific guidance
data.purpose: Serve the authored instructions appropriate to a module, workflow, client, or project state.

data.ef: runs requirement-tagged unit, integration, transport, persistence, and browser scenarios alongside lint and strict type checking, with CI jobs on Linux, macOS, and Windows
data.purpose: Improve the evidence that Metaform obeys its declared behavior and continues to work across supported systems and interfaces.

data.ef: exercises namespace and join shape, layer resolution, retained histories, concurrent storage, module ownership, installation and MCP, workflow binding, dispatch, and web operations against representative scenarios
data.purpose: Protect the functional-map contract and shared runtime behavior as implementations change.

data.ef: provides requirement IDs, acceptance conditions, and quality rules used to organize the verification scenarios and distinguish evidence from conclusions
data.purpose: Test requirements and their observable outcomes rather than treating implementation detail as the contract.

data.ef: develops the method's causal account, terminology, examples, research comparisons, authorship, and distinctions between existing mechanisms and proposed inference-producing operations
data.purpose: Explain why functional types, receiver-owned purposes, and retained encounters provide useful orientation for later agent work.

data.ef: preserves exported elements, joins, references, and recorded understanding for documented examples and historical snapshots without making their old shapes current runtime requirements
data.purpose: Keep inspectable examples of functional representations and earlier intake results so method claims can be compared with the records that support them.
data.note: Historical samples and procedure revisions are evidence of earlier forms. examples/intake/mgm-main/README.md and docs/EDITION.md identify older formats and source editions. Their represented functions are demonstration and comparison, not independent implementation of the systems they describe.

data.ef: records code reviews, test reviews, manual exercises, cold-build results, requirement traces, and interface evidence with their edition or source context
data.purpose: Retain the findings, evidence, and scope limits of earlier verification and review work.

data.ef: pairs seven authored source prompts with structured definitions and a manifest of intent and inputs, while separately retaining older workflow examples whose current compatibility is unverified
data.purpose: Preserve inspectable examples of turning authored task prompts into structured workflow definitions for later platform ingestion.
data.note: The current workflow module imports portable documents with workflow metadata and named logic records. These historical id/steps JSON examples are source material for authored conversion, not evidence that they execute under the current Axiom call transport.

data.ef: provides the configured Claude Code, Codex, or Gemini agent through its ACP adapter, project process environment, tool access, and streamed conversation protocol
data.purpose: Obtain an inference-capable agent session that can act on a ticket and exchange progress, messages, and permissions.

data.ef: performs the functional reasoning and records its results through the intake tools while Metaform transports and stores the procedure and records
data.purpose: Have the served intake procedure interpreted against the actual artifacts and their functionality.

data.ef: reads the current bound subroutine and values, interprets Choice, Map, Retry, Catch, verification, and routing, and uses the transport commands to advance or return
data.purpose: Interpret authored workflow conditions and choose calls without replacing the prompt's semantics with hardcoded control flow.

data.ef: provides local transactional databases for append-only operations, object identity, projection snapshots, and declared module tables
data.purpose: Durably commit ordered graph operations and module records with transactional consistency across processes.

data.ef: provides bundled graph layouts, two-dimensional and three-dimensional graph rendering, scene rendering, and diagram rendering used by the workbench
data.purpose: Render and navigate graph structure, spatial agent activity, and technical diagrams in the browser.

data.ef: creates the building intake layer, records elements and joins with content notices rather than rejection, stores refs in sources, and makes the finalized layer visible on completion
data.purpose: Persist the intake's inferred shape and references without publishing an unfinished layer to ordinary context reads.

data.ef: provides the Store interface, native map operations, extension operations, and versioned module tables with common ownership, removal, and import/export behavior
data.purpose: Give extension modules transactional data operations and declared tables through one shared public service.

data.ef: supplies live Module, Verb, Noun, Resource, setting, and status declarations from which the MCP server derives its callable surface and refresh notifications
data.purpose: Expose the enabled module capabilities and their exact argument help to connected agents.

data.ef: provides command declarations and Context-bound verb invocation, refreshes module selection, and scopes available operations without duplicating the module's implementation
data.purpose: Run the declared module operations through the same contract as other Metaform surfaces.

data.ef: returns roots, addressed joins, knowledge, properties, sources, history, work, and messages, and accepts graph refinements through the public Store operations used by the web server
data.purpose: Display and edit the selected project's map while obeying the same layer visibility as agent reads.

data.ef: returns read-only element values, receiver and provider encounters, properties, sources, memories and work, and assembles selected contextual or whole-layer knowledge between the unchanged prompt body and canonical address footer
data.purpose: Bind reusable logic and prepared prompts to the knowledge actually visible at their subject addresses.

data.ef: registers shared sections lazily, composes libraries from the newest stored sections, and exposes authored skills and prompt-lexicalization inputs without performing the inference itself
data.purpose: Serve current authored workflow libraries, skills, and lexicalization guidance while retaining prior prompt versions.

data.ef: provides ordered tickets, claim and completion state, step progress, work links, messages, permissions, and past resolutions used by ACP sessions and the board
data.purpose: Run eligible work once and keep its state, steps, questions, and results attached to the correct function.

data.ef: delivers map changes and dispatch or signal events to local subscribers and cross-process listeners while long-running runners record activity and react to work changes
data.purpose: Update remote workbench and session observers as agent activity or ticket state changes.

data.ef: creates review and upkeep tickets, starts the configured agent through declared dispatch verbs, retains verdicts and evidence, and waits for completion before packaging or continuation
data.purpose: Perform extension quality review and template upkeep through the project's existing agent work service.

data.ef: provides the concrete built wheel and dependency requirements that the installer launches through uvx and probes using the supported client registration
data.purpose: Register a distributable Metaform wheel containing the capabilities selected for installation.

data.ef: would trigger the fork's template-version comparison and upkeep work from the installation stage, whose connection has not yet been implemented
data.purpose: Keep the user's module repository current when installation brings in a newer Metaform template.

data.ef: holds the shared sections, libs and task skills, the sentinel among them, that the engine serves by name and binds with each run's input
data.purpose: Serve each agent the libs and skills its task requires, exactly as authored, so a workflow runs the instructions its authors wrote.

data.ef: reads the map's entry and any address with what relies on it, what it relies on, its open work and the layers in context there; writes the map out as Markdown or XML; answers Cypher and text searches; creates, builds, tags, selects, masks and hides knowledge layers; refines, promotes and collapses the base as new versions with every id kept; and starts blind-spot critic runs and records their challenges, answers and plans
data.purpose: Let agents and people read the functional map at the address they work on, and change the map and the knowledge layered on it, through one surface that obeys the same visibility rules everywhere.

data.ef: provides the roots, where, context, graph, search and history reads with the layers that reach each address resolved, and the element, join, item, property, refine, promote, collapse and layer writes, storing what does not fit as given and naming it in a notice
data.purpose: Answer every read and make every write through the one data access object, so a tool call, a command and the web GUI see the same map.

data.ef: stores work records with their condition, kind, planned and finished steps, reference links, board place, agent glyph and eligible agents, the questions and messages left at nodes, blind-spot challenge states and plans, and report rows, in the map module's own declared tables, and keeps completed work as past work at its node
data.purpose: Keep each finding, ticket, question and decision attached to the element or join it concerns, apart from the map's shape.

data.ef: presents a graph of entities, observations and relations at each node exactly as the MCP reference memory server does, attaches them to elements or joins by joins of type memory, shows them as the memory layer under layer selection, moves joins to a new address and lists those a new map orphans, and holds each node's one note, which only the page writes
data.purpose: Keep what agents learn and what the person notes at stable functional addresses, across sessions and later metaforms.

data.ef: keeps the memory module's declared project-level tables through the data access object and resolves the elements and joins of the active map that memory joins point to, so a join whose address the map no longer holds reads as orphaned
data.purpose: Keep the memory graph in the project's own store and tie it to the map's current addresses.

data.ef: runs the memory module's commands in the web server for the whole memory graph, the orphaned memory joins and each node's note, and writes the page's memory changes in order
data.purpose: Show the person the memories at a node as a graph of their own, and keep the person's one note there.

data.ef: records each database's layout version and the oldest layout whose code still reads and writes it, backs up and updates a store at an earlier layout forward, opens a newer store that is still compatible and leaves its numbers as they are, and refuses one that is not, naming the version it needs
data.purpose: Open every store written by older or newer code without misreading it or losing what it holds.

data.ef: keeps each loop's attempt count and MaxAttempts limit, opens each pass as a ticket at its nodes, decides from the pass's result whether to go again, and ends the run with its result delivered to the caller
data.purpose: End every loop of a workflow run by code, so no worker decides whether its own work goes again.

data.ef: issues the session's handoff nonce, whose run prints the handoff prompt and the where read of the ticket's node and each node it links, keeps the runner's recovery identities in it, and closes it when the session ends
data.purpose: Hand each ticket to an agent by one short code that brings it its task and the map around it.

data.ef: carries the current functional map of Metaform in the package as one exchange document, collapsed to a single finished intake layer with element and join ids kept and no knowledge, memory, sources or tickets, which an explicit metaform import adds as the metaform-release map
data.purpose: Let an agent developing Metaform, or a fork of it, start from Metaform's own recorded functional understanding instead of reconstructing it.

data.ef: makes a Project Archive, a Project + Metaform wheel, the Metaform Installer or Metaform Full from shape presets and a checklist of every module the loader finds, shows the build's real stages in a progress bar that stops at a failed stage with its next step, and hands the finished file to the browser while keeping it under the home's builds folder
data.purpose: Let the person make the build a destination needs from the page, and receive the file without looking for it.

data.ef: packs a Project Archive, the modules that declare remote use, and the person's task wrapped in Metaform's system prompt, or the onboarding prompt when no task is written, into one wheel that, run with Python alone, unpacks and registers the project, opens a working layer and prints the prompt, the modules' instructions and the map's entry; its return command writes the working layer, the file changes and a note as one Project Archive that metaform import adds as a new layer
data.purpose: Carry a project and its map to a remote agent system that offers only an upload, a chat and a download, and bring the agent's work back without anyone assembling files by hand.

data.ef: lists, loads and reads each skill folder by name or by its logic.skill address through a skills tool, with its libs fresh from the prompt store, and adds a compact index of the discoverable skills at connect for a harness the deploy record does not show
data.purpose: Let an agent in any harness find the skills meant to be found, and load any skill by its address.

data.ef: starts Claude Code, Codex or Gemini CLI on a ticket through its ACP adapter and streams the session to the ticket's node, queues messages and answers in order, interrupts or stops a turn, works an agent glyph's tickets in turn, autostarts waiting work, raises signals when an agent spins, fails repeatedly or waits on a permission, recovers dead runners by policy, starts the system agent and the conversation agents the person summons, starts a sentinel on an issue raised at a node whose chosen proposal becomes held tickets under a work claim, and holds a clean worktree merge for review before it lands
data.purpose: Run agent work on tickets against the map with every session observable, reachable and recoverable, and bring the person only agents whose purpose is to serve them.

data.ef: serves the intake procedure and schema with the project's ignore list, records one element or purpose join per call with its refs in the sources layer and its conditions as work records, refusing no content, shows the building map for review and activates it at finish; on a finished map it writes conditions and refs onto it and opens a new base only for new shape
data.purpose: Establish an artifact-specific functional map through the authored intake procedure without rejecting inferred content.

data.ef: registers each workpiece source under the Metaform home, resolves a folder's project and its bases, records origins and variants and reconstructs them with Python alone, exports and imports a project whole by unique id, saves process feedback, intake reports and shapes as files with one row each, and backs a project up before clearing it so one command restores it
data.purpose: Keep each workpiece's identity, functional maps, and physical revisions available across folders, variants, and transfers.

data.ef: draws the selected metaform and its layers in linked 2D and 3D views with upstream and downstream toggles, lights each node by its work and open questions, edits tasks, elements, notes, prompts and the layer choice, runs the Kanban board with agent glyphs, starts, follows, messages and stops agents and their chats, takes an issue raised on a node to a sentinel, exports the map as Markdown or XML, clears a project, serves saved web variants side by side, and follows every map change without polling
data.purpose: Inspect and change the functional map and coordinate addressed work through one live project workbench.

data.ef: keeps each base's elements, receiver-owned joins, knowledge items and properties with every version of them in one append-only op log per store, and resolves which layers reach each address for every read
data.purpose: Preserve and read the project's functional records with the knowledge and provenance selected for each address.

data.ef: detects the supported AI tools, previews and backs up every file it changes, registers the uvx server entry through each tool's own mechanism, copies the one skill and the global instruction pointers, proves each registered launch starts the server, asks an unfamiliar harness on its first run to provision what it supports, and removes what it added on uninstall
data.purpose: Connect supported agent clients to a concrete, validated Metaform installation.

data.ef: parses verbs, nouns, switches and aliases, keeps every long switch as a folder setting with default, set and glued states, derives help from the live declarations, asks the design's questions through the store's reads, and opens the terminal settings screen, each resolved from the working folder's project
data.purpose: Operate Metaform and its modules from the working folder with consistent arguments, settings, help, and next actions.

data.ef: exposes each session's activity, state and chat, ticket claims, messages, questions, interruption and stop, raised issues with their sentinel chats and proposals, work claims and Autostart agents to the page through public dispatch verbs and map-change notifications
data.purpose: Make addressed agent work observable and controllable from the project workbench.
